title: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa ambukizi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child counts the ideas (verbs with their subjects): one idea is sahili; two joined by na, lakini, au, ila is ambatano.
steps: Find the verbs and their subjects.
contexts: infectious diseases: Alikohoa lakini hakwenda hospitali

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels three sentences and joins two simple ones.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi ambatano ina nini?" Kwa nini "Wazo moja tu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi ambatano huunganisha mawazo mawili au zaidi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ni ambatano?" Kwa nini "Mama anapika." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahili?" Kwa nini "Alikuja lakini aliondoka." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi sahili ina wazo moja, hata ikiwa ndefu.
Sentensi ambatano huunganishwa kwa kiunganishi: na, lakini, au.
